scope: Pure statistical helper, mock-only tests and supplied test log. No arm caches, responses, result tables or efficacy summaries read.

coverage_checked: phase gate before iteration of outcome-bearing inputs
fully observed pair analysis separated from incomplete pairs
partial pair known counterpart retained in every completion
all 256 binary assignments for eight unknown response cells
exact scheduled-cohort bounds for whole and partial unavailable pairs
all-completion whole and partial pair bootstrap equivalence to frozen statistics
20,000 frozen bootstrap draws with seed 246600 on a 600-pair mock
identity mismatch, duplication, missing row and imputation rejection
deterministic output and no input mutation
positive, negative, flat and near-boundary primary-claim cases

review_findings.phase_gate: Checks interventions_complete before iterating selection, intervention or unavailable inputs.
review_findings.partial_missingness: Unknown cells are bound by request key/case/arm; incomplete pairs are excluded from complete-pair inference while observed counterparts remain fixed in scheduled-cohort completions.
review_findings.bounds: Bounds account for known cell contributions and each unknown arm cell's binary contribution.
review_findings.completions: Enumerates all binary assignments to unknown response cells and marks them hypothetical.
review_findings.bootstrap: Uses frozen selected-case order, RNG seed and draw count; mocks compare every whole- and partial-pair completion with frozen paired statistics.
review_findings.primary_criterion: Requires positive repair-minus-fresh difference and exact two-sided McNemar p below 0.05 in every completion.
review_findings.no_imputation: Rejects response-bearing unavailable rows and mismatched or incomplete allowlists.

scope_limits: Amendment 003 request identity mapping and raw cache inventory not checked here.
Runtime overlay and final report wiring require separate reviews.
No intervention outputs or efficacy results were inspected.
